_single_run_gate_note: Quarantined from the single-run gate (gotcha 10): the honest-decline wording is a model-dependent quality assertion. The CRITICAL handoff_trail_must_not_contain (browser_agent) STILL gates — the failure mode this guards is the orchestrator dispatching the browser to 'go look' when it has no page context, which it must never do.
description: Companion to 041 (#312, the no-context path). With NO AgentRequest.context block, 'what's on my screen?' cannot be answered — the orchestrator must honestly say it can't see the page, NOT dispatch the Browser Agent to go fetch something (there's no URL to fetch, and a non-Electron client has no page). Guards the regression where the page-context prompt rule leaks into the no-context case and makes the orchestrator hallucinate a page or waste a browser dispatch.

input.user_message: What's currently on my screen right now?
